description_en: Queries one or more key pairs
description_zh: 调用DescribeKeyPairs查询一个或多个密钥对
kebab_example: aliyun ens describe-key-pairs --biz-key-pair-name TestKeyPairName --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --key-pair-id ssh-50cynkq42sgj4ej1tn78t4000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeKeyPairs

parameters.help_en:
The name of the key pair that you want to bind to the simple application server. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. The name must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain the following characters:

Numbers.

:

_

.

You can specify only one name. By default, all key pairs are queried
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含以下字符：
数字
:
_
.

仅支持传单个名称。默认查询所有密钥对信息
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the returned page. Valid values: integers that are greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询列表的页码。取值：>0，默认查询第1页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: integers that are greater than 0. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值：>0，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the key pair
parameters.name: key_pair_id

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the key pair was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 密钥对的创建时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

KeyPairFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the key pair

KeyPairId.description_en: The ID of the key pair

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the SSH key pair

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of key pairs
